The '''Liberty task force''' was under the command of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']].

The following [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were often seen accompanying the ''Liberty'' before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. They were supplied by the company [[Greppem Freight]].
